text:
sara_sales: Heads up  AcmeBank wants an EU-only POC: tenant must be pinned to eu-west-1, no egress outside EU even on failover, and they require BYO-KMS (AWS KMS in eu-west-1). Need a one-page rate card delta + short SOW. Can we support? @ben_se @nina_sec

ben_se: We can. Two quick Qs: 1) hard pin (no cross-region failover) confirmed? 2) Do they want monitoring/metrics in-path or can metrics be pulled via dedicated, EU-only stack?

maya_cto: Confirmed hard pin. Legal won't accept any cross-border copy. Metrics must stay in EU or be removed from the critical data path.

nina_sec: Security note: BYO-KMS with AWS KMS is OK but they usually want HSM-backed keys. We'll treat AWS KMS (with CloudHSM) as baseline and provide an attestation template. Also will need the full subprocessor inventory filtered for EU-only dependencies.

carlos_prod: Implementation approach: provision Dedicated EU cluster in eu-west-1, tenant pinning config with failover disabled, BYO-KMS integration to accept customer CMKs, and remove/replace any US SaaS telemetry. Expect infra + config + QA work.

ben_se: Proposed SOW snippet (pseudo):
```
- Provision Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-1), reserved capacity
- Configure tenant_pin policy: regions_allowed=["eu-west-1"], failover=disabled
- BYO-KMS onboarding & key validation (AWS KMS eu-west-1)
- Subprocessor attestation & contract amendment
- QA: no-egress verification and proof report
- Handover + runbook
```

sara_sales: Price delta ballpark vs hosted? they asked for rough numbers to close MSA.

carlos_prod: Ballpark: Dedicated EU pinned + BYO-KMS + removing third-party telemetry = ~+30% on hosted list, with variance 2040% depending on commit and whether we can keep some infra shared. 12mo commit brings it down ~5 points. Also add monthly minimum for reserved pool.

infra_bot: Ticket INF-5902 created for Dedicated EU provisioning. ETA: 6 business days for initial cluster, extra 3 days for networking and KMS peering.

ben_se: Timeline (target POC kickoff in 3 weeks): Week0: finalize SOW & pricing; Week1: provision cluster & KMS key exchange; Week2: onboard tenant & QA; Week3: customer validation. Risk: infra ETA currently tight.

nina_sec: Action items for security: produce subprocessor list filtered to EU, prepare attestation template, answer SQ. Target EOD.

sara_sales: I'll send the draft SOW + rate card to AcmeBank and ask for confirmation on 12mo vs month-to-month. Ben please drop the SOW draft here today. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
